Korean MMORPG character artwork. Age: late twenties — a graceful grown-up face with soft, smooth contours; no wrinkles, folds or under-eye bags.
Face — her own: a cool, aloof beauty; warm beige skin; face with soft jaw angles that taper gently toward a rounded chin, not wide from the front; softly deep-set eyes of natural size; storm-grey eyes; soft rounded brows; a nose with a slightly upturned tip; softly full, heart-shaped lips of natural size.
Skin finish: dewy, glass-like highlights on the skin of her shoulders, arms, collarbones and legs — a soft, luminous wet-look sheen that follows the body's forms; her face keeps a soft, natural finish.
Body and hair: curvy build; a high braided crown feeding into a thick single braid down her back; deep wine-red hair.

Anatomy: one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; natural hands with five fingers.

Costume: grand, opulent dress of a mythic court cut to the outfit silhouette below — rich silk brocade dense with gold-thread embroidery, gilded filigree and jewel settings, enchanted jewelry with a soft magical glow; the city's symbol worked into the embroidery and jewels.

Silhouette: layered panels flowing like waves, strands of pearls and a shell-shaped headdress — a rippling tide-oracle silhouette. Prop: in one hand she holds a slender gold scepter topped with a glowing apple of amber-red crystal; her other hand is free.
Exposure (bold): her outfit opens to show skin where its silhouette allows — bare shoulders and arms, a deep open neckline with natural cleavage, and a high slit or a short hem showing the thigh; the ornaments stay on and symmetrical. Intimate areas covered.

World: a radiant royal harbour capital of a Western myth-world at sunrise, on a long island between two shining rivers: ranks of tall white-marble and gold towers stepping back as they rise, topped with gilded sunburst crests that catch the dawn; at the mouth of the great harbour a colossal guardian of verdigris-green bronze raising a torch of living golden flame; a great bridge of pale stone with twin pointed-arch towers and fans of silver cable reaching to the eastern shore; and a vast walled forest garden of lakes and carved stone terraces in the heart of the island, all under a rose-and-gold sky.
This card: on the white marble harbour stairs below the colossal verdigris-green guardian raising her torch of living flame, gilded barges and white sails on the shining water and the towered island capital behind her.

Stance and hands: She holds the scepter diagonally in her left hand and gently lifts the edge of an outer silk panel with her open right hand.
Light: a soft key light with a strong rim light tracing her hair, shoulders and armour; bright, crisp specular highlights on metal and jewellery, and a clean, warm-neutral sheen on her skin.
Composition: vertical 2:3 full-body framing with modest headroom and clear space below the boots — the whole figure from the top of her head or headpiece to both feet stays inside the frame, occupying about four-fifths of the image height, with the same camera distance in every world; her hands stay inside the frame. Camera level with her face with natural portrait perspective; her head level, chin neither raised nor tucked — no upward perspective on her face, no wide-angle distortion, no low angle, no close crop.

One figure only; no text, lettering or numbers anywhere in the picture; no logo or watermark.
